case_title.reason: Header matches the judgment's case title.

accused_gender.reason: Judgment does not state the accused's gender.

accused_religion.reason: No religion of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is stated.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No wealth or class statement about the accused appears.

victim_gender.reason: Victim is referred to as 'he' and 'the deceased' Saravanan; male is supported.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Prior dispute/suspicion: accused suspected the deceased of informing on the whereabouts of Selvakumar (a friend of the accused); otherwise not stated
accused_victim_relationship.quote: owing to animosity between the friend of the accused viz., Selvakumar and one Periyavan @ Murugan ... Suspecting that the deceased Saravanan had informed the whereabouts of Selvakumar
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment's animosity is between Selvakumar and Periyavan; accused-victim link is suspicion, not enmity.

offence_category.reason: Charges are under s.302 IPC for murder.

statutory_provisions.reason: Sections 302, 302 r/w 34, 341, 506(2) IPC and TNPPDL Act s.3(1) match the judgment.

weapon.quote: broke the wind screen of the car with aruvals
weapon.reason: Aruvals are correct, but 'machete-type' is not stated in the judgment.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness PW1, recovered blood-stained aruvals, postmortem and clothing evidence are all referenced.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating facts are noted by the court.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced each of them to undergo life imprisonment and fine of Rs. 1,000/- each, in default, three months simple imprisonment
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court's convictions, life sentences and fines.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court allowed the appeals and acquitted the accused.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court set aside the acquittal and restored convictions.

offence_finally_established.reason: Convictions under s.302 and s.302 r/w s.34 are restored as stated.

imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment is the sentence restored.

imprisonment_years.reason: Not a fixed term, so null is right.

fine_rs.reason: Fine of Rs. 1,000 each is stated.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary covers incident and evidence, uses no names or outcome, and stops before court proceedings.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory maximum or minimum punishment.

attempt_completion.reason: Victim was killed, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Shoulder injury, further injuries in the shed, and death are described.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 4 charged (IPC ss.341, 506(2), 302; TNPPDL Act s.3(1)); 1 section finally upheld (IPC s.302, with s.34 for A2 and A3; two convictions)
number_of_offences.quote: convicting the accused for the offences under Sections 302 and 302 r/w 34 IPC is hereby restored
number_of_offences.reason: Charged count is right, but upheld count treats s.302 r/w 34 as a separate section; it is one section with two convictions.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property or money loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.reason: The judgment makes no finding of premeditation or planning.

motive.quote: Suspecting that the deceased Saravanan had informed the whereabouts of Selvakumar
motive.reason: Alleged motive of suspected informing about a murdered friend's whereabouts matches the prosecution case.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Deposition of PW1, the sole eyewitness, on both the attack in the car and the attack in the shed
key_evidence_accepted.quote: there can be a conviction on the basis of the deposition of the sole eye witness, if the said witness is found to be trustworthy and/or reliable
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied only on PW1's testimony; it did not accept the aruvals or clothing evidence.

witness_credibility.quote: PW1 stood by what he has stated and has fully supported the case of the prosecution
witness_credibility.reason: Accurately reflects the court's assessment of PW1 as a star, reliable eyewitness.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Ran away after the attack in the shed (per PW1); arrests on 02.08.2013 and 17.08.2013 noted
post_offence_conduct.quote: came out of the shed and ran away
post_offence_conduct.reason: Court noted the accused ran away after the attack, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

bail_history.reason: No bail grant or refusal is mentioned.

trial_duration.reason: Offence, High Court and Supreme Court dates match; trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel for the appellant (State) and respondents (accused) match the judgment.

investigation_status.reason: FIR, investigation, charge sheet and committal to Sessions are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: High Court noted unmarked complaint, late FIR dispatch and constable not examined; Supreme Court's holding is accurate.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court acquittal and Supreme Court restoration are accurately stated.

prosecution_argument.reason: State's argument on PW1 and both parts of the incident, relying on Krishna Mochi, is accurate.

defence_argument.reason: All listed defence submissions, including Kunju Muhammed reliance, appear in the judgment.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Sole eyewitness conviction, non-necessity of weapon recovery and FIR timing principles are applied.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Krishna Mochi relied on by State; Kunju Muhammed cited by defence and referred to by the court.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court gives no sentencing reasoning; 'Not applicable' fits.

other_sentence_order.reason: Surrender direction within six weeks and custody direction match the judgment.
